operations.title: Check the supply model and input-voltage selector
operations.title_ja: 電源の型番と入力電圧の設定を確認
operations.note: The official diagram locates an input-voltage selector where fitted. Check the exact supply and manufacturer documentation; this source model has no electrical selector state.

operations.title: Check the power-supply position and mounting method
operations.title_ja: 電源の固定位置と方法を確認
operations.note: The guide specifies a 1–2 mm body-to-frame gap and shows adhesive mounting or an alternative with two M3x6 screws and drilled holes. This original CAD position and its unmodeled adhesive/alternative fasteners are not a qualified mounting.

operations.title: Disconnect power before wiring work
operations.title_ja: 配線前に電源を切り離す
operations.note: Follow the official power-off checks before wiring. This viewer does not determine whether the real machine can be energized.

operations.title: Distinguish AC, protective earth and DC
operations.title_ja: AC・保護接地・DCを区別して確認
operations.note: Check the official diagram for L/N/PE and V+/V-. Protective earth and controller GND are different references; do not identify a connection solely by wire color.

operations.title: Check the mains-inlet wiring diagram
operations.title_ja: インレットの配線図を確認
operations.note: The official page shows the separate inlet wiring before installation. Mains work requires personnel qualified under local rules. The source inlet remains a complete purchased unit; wire lengths, terminals, routing and electrical checks are not represented as completed.

operations.title: Locate the complete inlet in its printed foot
operations.title_ja: インレットを足部の取付位置に合わせる
operations.note: Compare the complete inlet and its own printed receiving foot with the official diagram. This is source placement reference; a snap-in path, engagement and retention have not been established.

operations.title: Check the mains connections and wire retention
operations.title_ja: AC側の接続と配線の保持を確認
operations.note: Use the exact official inlet-to-supply diagram and retain the wires as shown. A terminal cover follows later. This model contains no qualified external harness, terminals or protective-earth continuity test.

operations.title: Check DC power and controller-fan connections
operations.title_ja: DC電源と基板冷却ファンの接続を確認
operations.note: Use this edition of the official diagram for supply, board and controller fan. The V0.2 and r1 printed cross-section entries differ; do not silently treat the mm²/AWG text as an electrical equivalence or validated cable selection.

operations.title: Identify the heaters, thermistors and fans
operations.title_ja: ヒーター・サーミスタ・ファンを確認
operations.note: The official diagram assumes 24V cooling fans. Verify actual device ratings and identities rather than using colors alone. The source head fans are identifiable, while physical external harness and heater/thermistor terminal correspondence remain open.

operations.title: Compare the A, B, Z and E motor positions
operations.title_ja: A・B・Z・Eモーターの位置を照合
operations.note: The official drawing identifies B as X and A as Y. Compare these with their exact source drive assemblies and the Z/E motors. Do not infer electrical phase or pin assignment from motor wire colors.

operations.title: Use the diagram for the actual SKR Pico board
operations.title_ja: SKR Picoの配線図と照合
operations.note: Keep the source SKR Pico complete. Compare the X/Y DIAG and device connections with the official Pico diagram; the E3 V3 diagram is a different board. No individual CAD connector-to-pin mapping or wiring is yet qualified.

operations.title: Check Pi power and the selected communication option
operations.title_ja: Piの電源と通信方式を確認
operations.note: The guide distinguishes USB/UART and shows a separate E3 V3 power alternative. Do not substitute that board or a generic converter into this Pico source assembly. Pi power, cable and firmware configuration require the exact selected hardware.

operations.title: Position the supply terminal guard after wiring checks
operations.title_ja: 配線確認後に端子カバーを合わせる
operations.note: The official guard reduces accidental terminal contact. Its displayed source position does not certify electrical safety, retention or whole-machine clearance.
